flags.message: Decisive post-snapshot forward signal (forward cell, snapshot 2026-01-13): the underlying no-poach action has settled out (Huntington Ingalls/Marinette/Serco affiliate settlements 2026-03-19; plaintiffs dismissed General Dynamics from the suit) and petitioners moved on 2026-05-18 to hold the petition in abeyance (SCOTUSblog timeline; Law360). No disposition of the petition itself was surfaced — CourtListener shows the docket unterminated — so this is forward signal, not leakage, but it moved the forecast from ~0.45 (post-CVSG dynamics) to 0.05 with `dismissed` as the modal disposition. supremecourt.gov's docket page returned HTTP 403, so the abeyance/settlement picture rests on secondary reporting.
